step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram displays a multi-region deployment pipeline. A developer (UserCompanyDeveloper) commits code/manifest via Git to S3. S3 triggers an SNS topic for global fanout across regions. In each region, Lambda processes the event, dynamically generates CloudFormation templates, and queues deployment tasks in SQS, which then deploys the applications into Amazon EKS.

graph.name: Instructure Global Multi-Region Deployment Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture for automated global deployments using S3, SNS, Lambda, CloudFormation, SQS, and EKS.
